title: Project: classes in practice and Maven

objectives.text: Model a described real-world entity as a class whose constructor and methods keep every object valid

Guard and handle null where it is permitted, with a null check or getOrDefault, and reject a forbidden null argument at once with Objects.requireNonNull, which throws NullPointerException with a clear message
Declare a test-scope dependency in the project's POM, then run the public tests with mvn -q -o test and tell a compile failure from a failing test
